limits: Screen-space Deferred surface diffusion is approximate; no hidden-surface transmission.
Direct and SH diffuse have separate diffusion plumbing; SSGI/SurfelGI retain their existing unfiltered contribution. Native SSS controls use direct lighting.
Hi-Z uses same-frame conservative opaque indexed bounds, with a real depth prepass; MSAA above 1x falls back to direct draws.
Windows native DX12 execution was unavailable; DXIL shaders were compiled, native validation used macOS Vulkan/MoltenVK.
